newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EA-Generali group to finalise CA bid.
newsitem.headline: EA-Generali group to finalise CA bid.

text.p: An EA-Generali-led group chasing a stake in Austria's Creditanstalt-Bankverein said it would meet later on Thursday to finalise its offer and consider the emergence of Bank Austria as a rival.
"The consortium will meet during the afternoon to formulate its final, firm bid and discuss the current situation," an EA-Generali spokesman told Reuters.
Until Wednesday the consortium, which groups Austrian, German and Italian financial and industrial interests, had ranked as favourite to take on the state's Creditanstalt stake.
A late decision by market leader Bank Austria to enter the fray and reportedly outbid the EA-Generali group has altered the picture.
Bank Austria is reported to be willing to pay 804 schillings a share for the state's 19.9 million ordinary shares, representing 70 percent of voting stock.
The EA-Generali consortium had reportedly indicated it would pay 720-730 schillings per share for two thirds of the government's holding.
Final bids have to be in by December 16. Finance Minister Viktor Klima has said he wants to reach a decision by year-end. -- Janet McBride, Vienna Newsroom 43-1-531 12 254
